steps.name: Friend's Whereabouts (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Soreyu] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”, go to [Sera] in the “Guild Inn”.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm sorry for asking you to come when you're busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I took some time to come here. Lena told me to rest for a while, but I didn't think I could just stay still.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: By Lena, do you mean Lord Lena Hiren of Silver Claws?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I'm currently staying at the Guild Alliance Inn.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: If you're at an inn, you're probably drinking alcohol. Did you bring a royal decree from His Majesty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. So he told me to wait a little while.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (It’s Your Majesty’s business….)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina spots %s from a distance and runs over.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I was just thinking of Adventurer, I never thought I would see it here like this. I guess I missed you a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you... . It’s been a long time since I’ve had someone welcome me so warmly.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's only been a few days, but it seems like Shiina likes Adventurer a lot, to the point where she says she misses you.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Because Adventurer deserves it. Hehehe,

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don’t think my juniors welcomed me this warmly when I arrived… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior, school was a mess back then! Instead, I will hug you like this. Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, yes. are you okay!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a nice sight. Oh, that's right. Soreyu, didn’t you have something to ask of me?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's because I haven't been able to contact Platinum these days. I don't know where I am or what I'm doing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw it a few times at the Belfar Library... . I don't think I've seen it since then either.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Could you please find out where Platinum is?  Whenever Platinum was out of sight for a moment, something was always going on.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Maybe it will be a hint about His Majesty's edict.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, I'm curious. Then, I will come and visit on my own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then who should I ask... Ah, let's go to Sera at the guild inn first.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Soreyu? Then don't go anywhere, just wait here until I come. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes. There's still some time left before school gets sorted out, so I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Soreyu and Shiina see %s off until he disappears into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It’s an edict… . Is your sister asking Adventurer something?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I think it's probably important.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I hope it's not a big deal, but it's probably not something out of the ordinary, right?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It might not be normal, but don't worry too much. %s will do well.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Well then, Shiina, shall we go back in to organize things?  There's still a lot to do.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior!

steps.name: Friend's Whereabouts (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Leviathan Krill] in "Coral Song" and obtain <Green Dragon Turtle Crystal>, and defeat [Cupcake Shukri] in "Monstertree Mountain Valley" to obtain <High-Quality Flour>. Then report to Sarah at the “Guild Inn”.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Ugh, busy, busy. We have to find food ingredients and fill empty wooden beer kegs.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I need to get paid, but there hasn't been any news from my senior for several days without even telling me where he's going... .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Woof… … .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera seems to have lost her mind for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hey, %s. Were you there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I was standing in front just now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Am I that insignificant?)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I was so busy that I was out of my mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. If you are too busy, you can lose your mentality.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Do you need anything? Please speak. We will provide you with the best service during your stay at the inn.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera's business smile is so dazzling that I can't open my eyes properly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it's no different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Sarah that you are looking for Platinum.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: (Sera's eyes suddenly sparkle and she grabs %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: %s!! That's it!! We need to catch the evil employer who ran away immediately... , No, we have to find the missing Platinum senior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think my true feelings came out for a moment... . Bad employer blah blah blah… .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: No. My senior is my idol. You clearly heard wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me where you might have gone?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Oh, the last time I saw you, you said you were going to Giendia and Mirgandia areas. wait a minute. Recall some memories.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Ah! That's right, that's right. There it is!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: They said they were going to visit a place called Coral Song and a valley of Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. Then I'll go and see if there's a platinum.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Just a moment. While you're gone, could you please get this item for me? My senior told me that there were good ingredients there.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: It is a high-quality flour made from green dragon turtle crystals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Thanks for letting me know!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Please be careful!

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: %s, was your senior there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even when I got there, I couldn't see Platinum. Instead, I got the right items.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Thank you. Where on earth did my real senior go?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hmm. Wait a minute. Think about it.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I think it was there. Ah, what was the name there?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: They said that there were priests in the form of dragons staying there, and that I couldn't enter there without permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they are priests in the form of dragons... .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I guess you have to be a platina senior or something like that to be able to enter. (sniff)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: A temple knight like me needs to train a little more.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I heard that I met Adventurer there. You know there, right? Oh, I don't remember the name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Again, Zenadia… I don’t remember that place…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Genadia’s memories remain like a blurry afterimage.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What made you think Platinum would be there?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I remember you saying that it becomes easier if you organize your thoughts there.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: But that doesn't mean I'm back in a sanctuary full of complexities... . Even if it's a bit of a hassle, why not go there once?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I'll come back sometime.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Yes, please tell the poor junior that he can't even get the equipment he wants to buy due to lack of funds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go. To Genadia….)

steps.name: Friend's Whereabouts (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Retum] at “Warriors’ Rest” and obtain <Annals of the Kingdom of Belkia>. Then deliver it to [Soreyu] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: %s, how are we here…? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Found it, Platinum!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This is my own place that not many people know about... . Ah, %s, you probably know this place well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t remember well….)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You look like you have no idea... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (As expected from His Majesty, you have lost your memory...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehehe, do you not remember the exciting first meeting with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t think so. (Straight face)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But there’s no need to look at it with a straight face!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Why did I come here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Platina that Soreille and Sera are looking for her.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … Ah, I see. I feel sorry for everyone. Not only did I always make Soreyu come to me like this, but I also made him worry about my salary... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Don't worry too much! I'm a Paladin Platinum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren’t you acting too relaxed for something like that?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ahahaha. Does it look like that? Phew… .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I have a lot on my mind these days. I always come here to gather my thoughts before an important battle.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I thought it was already time for His Majesty to call. Perhaps some message was sent to Adventurer this time too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that Lena will deliver His Majesty's royal decree in a few days.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It won't be a big deal, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone always said it wasn't a big deal, but it was a bigger deal than I thought. So I'm thinking that way this time too.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: If you can afford it, you'll do well. I'll go and pay Sera's salary soon, and I don't think I'll be able to see Soreyu for a while... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll have to tell it to you instead. What should I say?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: What needs to be conveyed is not words, but things... . Adventurer, could you get one item on the way and bring it to Soreille?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. What is it?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This is a book about the Kingdom of Belkia that was recently discovered in the Mirgandia region. I think Soreyu will be helpful in my research.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: If you look at the graveyard where the Belkia Kingdom army rests, you will find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Platinum. Then, organize your thoughts well. I'll go then.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Phew… I wonder if Senior Aurum is doing well... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Seeing that you are walking lightly, I see that you have met Platinum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The issue of overdue salaries was also resolved.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes? ah… . The inn of the guild union. Platinum is coming... . But what are you holding in your hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I worked hard to get it. [The Annals of the Kingdom of Belkia].

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (Soreille looks back and forth between the book and %s with an incredulous expression.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: No, how do I do this... . I've only heard about it, but no one has ever seen it in person. Even imperial explorers couldn't find it properly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? is it so? Platina told me that this book was recently discovered and that I should bring it to Soreille as soon as I can find it.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, is that so?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Platinum receives news from the imperial capital faster than I do.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you. I think this will help a lot with what I'm looking into.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind, may I ask what it is about?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's a bit complicated, but I'll keep it simple.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There were great wizards on each continent. In addition to Archmage Zerenis, there was also an unknown female mage in Freios.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: While many wizards fought for their own power and country, he fought for those who did not belong and suffered.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There was also a boy warrior with the wizard, and according to a book in the Belfar Library, he later went to Eastland and became a superhuman.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The wizard disappeared at some point, but before that, he conveyed his intentions to someone. That was a young wizard from the Kingdom of Belkia.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: However, the young wizard did not follow the great wizard's wishes, but instead told King Letum and began to study the wizard's magic separately.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Although King Letum was known as a saint, he was actually a man with strong desires. It is said that while researching magic, they discovered one thing about a missing female wizard.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It is said that he used magic that all wizards, including the humans and elves of Freios, could not use.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: This is what I know so far. You can't go anywhere and talk about this. The Magic Agency is not allowed to know any more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why the Magic Agency?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … I don't think I can tell you that much. sorry. I'll let you know later when I know more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious, but I can't help it. Thank you for the story, Soreyu. Then I'll go. See you again later.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, %s. Then please be careful.
